prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 2 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 3 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 4 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 5 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 6 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import base64
import hashlib
import os
import secrets
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urljoin

import requests


@dataclass
class PKCEAuthResult:
    authorization_url: str
    state: str
    code_verifier: str
    code_challenge: str
    token_response: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    userinfo_response: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


class Auth0PKCEClient:
    """
    PKCE login flow for a public client against Auth0 Authentication API.

    Required environment variables:
      - AUTH0_DOMAIN: e.g. "your-tenant.us.auth0.com"
      - AUTH0_CLIENT_ID: public application client id

    Optional environment variables:
      - AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI: redirect URI registered in Auth0 (default: http://localhost:8000/callback)
      - AUTH0_SCOPE: requested scopes (default: openid profile email)
      - AUTH0_AUDIENCE: optional API audience
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
        redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
        scope: Optional[str] = None,
        audience: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.domain = domain or os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
        self.client_id = client_id or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
        self.redirect_uri = redirect_uri or os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8000/callback")
        self.scope = scope or os.environ.get("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
        self.audience = audience if audience is not None else os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")

        if not self.domain:
            raise ValueError("Missing AUTH0_DOMAIN")
        if not self.client_id:
            raise ValueError("Missing AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")

        self.issuer = f"https://{self.domain}"
        self.authorize_endpoint = urljoin(self.issuer, "/authorize")
        self.token_endpoint = urljoin(self.issuer, "/oauth/token")
        self.userinfo_endpoint = urljoin(self.issuer, "/userinfo")

    @staticmethod
    def _b64url_no_padding(data: bytes) -> str:
        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")

    @classmethod
    def generate_pkce_pair(cls) -> tuple[str, str]:
        verifier = cls._b64url_no_padding(secrets.token_bytes(64))
        challenge = cls._b64url_no_padding(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
        return verifier, challenge

    @staticmethod
    def generate_state() -> str:
        return secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

    def build_authorization_url(self, state: str, code_challenge: str, nonce: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        params = {
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "response_type": "code",
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "scope": self.scope,
            "state": state,
            "code_challenge": code_challenge,
            "code_challenge_method": "S256",
        }
        if nonce:
            params["nonce"] = nonce
        if self.audience:
            params["audience"] = self.audience

        return f"{self.authorize_endpoint}?{urlencode(params)}"

    def start_login(self) -> PKCEAuthResult:
        verifier, challenge = self.generate_pkce_pair()
        state = self.generate_state()
        authorization_url = self.build_authorization_url(state=state, code_challenge=challenge)
        return PKCEAuthResult(
            authorization_url=authorization_url,
            state=state,
            code_verifier=verifier,
            code_challenge=challenge,
        )

    def exchange_code_for_tokens(
        self,
        authorization_code: str,
        code_verifier: str,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload = {
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "code": authorization_code,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "code_verifier": code_verifier,
        }
        response = requests.post(self.token_endpoint, json=payload, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

    def fetch_userinfo(self, access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"}
        response = requests.get(self.userinfo_endpoint, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

    def complete_login(
        self,
        authorization_code: str,
        code_verifier: str,
    ) -> PKCEAuthResult:
        token_response = self.exchange_code_for_tokens(authorization_code, code_verifier)
        access_token = token_response.get("access_token")
        userinfo_response = None
        if access_token:
            userinfo_response = self.fetch_userinfo(access_token)

        return PKCEAuthResult(
            authorization_url="",
            state="",
            code_verifier=code_verifier,
            code_challenge="",
            token_response=token_response,
            userinfo_response=userinfo_response,
        )


def create_pkce_login_flow(
    authorization_code: Optional[str] = None,
    *,
    domain: Optional[str] = None,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
    scope: Optional[str] = None,
    audience: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = Auth0PKCEClient(
        domain=domain,
        client_id=client_id,
        redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
        scope=scope,
        audience=audience,
    )

    initial = client.start_login()
    result: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "authorization_url": initial.authorization_url,
        "state": initial.state,
        "code_verifier": initial.code_verifier,
        "code_challenge": initial.code_challenge,
    }

    if authorization_code:
        completed = client.complete_login(authorization_code, initial.code_verifier)
        result["token_response"] = completed.token_response
        result["userinfo_response"] = completed.userinfo_response

    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    flow = create_pkce_login_flow()
    print(flow["authorization_url"])
